value.reason: This is a config key from the OWASP Juice Shop CTF settings (ctf.countryMapping.<challenge>.name). It holds the country name that the 'persistedXssUserChallenge' challenge is mapped to for capture-the-flag scoring, such as a value like 'Uruguay'. It is static app configuration, not data about a real person, and it has no identifiers, credentials, financial, health, biometric or child data. None of the allowed categories fits exactly. 'Profile' is the closest and lowest-risk choice because the value is a descriptive country or location label. In practice this field holds no personal data.
